headline: HOU @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 3.44 at TEX 3.73, with a projected total of 7.16. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: HOU moved +0.33 runs while TEX moved -1.29, changing the projected margin by +1.62 runs. The projected total fell -0.95, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Mike Burrows has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ezequiel Duran, Jake Burger, Cam Smith, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Zach Cole, Andrew McCutchen because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
